items.exampleEn: Phone cameras have popularized taking photos of food.
items.exampleZh: 手機相機讓拍食物照片變得普及。

items.exampleEn: The movie was criticized for glorifying dangerous driving.
items.exampleZh: 那部電影因為美化危險駕駛而受到批評。

items.exampleEn: Members of the aristocracy often had their pictures painted.
items.exampleZh: 貴族階級的成員常常請人為自己畫像。

items.exampleEn: The humanist wrote many books about human dignity.
items.exampleZh: 那位人文主義者寫了許多談人性尊嚴的書。

items.exampleEn: In her novel, even the bad guy is humanized: we learn about his lonely childhood.
items.exampleZh: 在她的小說裡，連反派都被寫得有人性：我們看到他孤單的童年。

items.exampleEn: Tourists come to see the gravestone of the famous poet.
items.exampleZh: 遊客前來參觀那位知名詩人的墓碑。

items.exampleEn: She prefers Shakespearean comedies to Shakespearean tragedies.
items.exampleZh: 比起莎士比亞的悲劇，她更喜歡莎士比亞的喜劇。

items.sentenceEn: Our history teacher humanizes the past by telling stories of ordinary families.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的歷史老師講平凡家庭的故事，讓過去更有人情味。

items.audioEn: This TV chef helped popularize Thai food in our country.
items.audioZh: 這位電視廚師幫助泰國菜在我們國家普及。
items.questionZh: 這位電視廚師做了什麼？
options: Opened Thai restaurants in every city
Made more people like Thai dishes

items.sentenceEn: The actor spoke in a Shakespearean style that made the audience laugh.
items.sentenceZh: 那位演員用莎士比亞式的說話風格逗得觀眾大笑。

items.sentenceEn: The old song glorifies the hard work of farmers.
items.sentenceZh: 那首老歌讚頌農民的辛勤工作。

items.stemEn: Cheap flights have helped ____ travel to small islands.
items.stemZh: 便宜的機票讓去小島旅行變得普及。

items.stemEn: The name on the two-hundred-year-old ____ was almost impossible to read.
items.stemZh: 那塊兩百年的墓碑上的名字幾乎無法辨認。

items.passageEn: Every summer, a small theater group in our city performs a Shakespearean play in the park. This year they chose a story about the English aristocracy, full of kings, princes and secret love. The director, a humanist who believes art belongs to everyone, wanted to popularize old plays among young people. So she humanized the characters: the proud princes sent text messages and argued about money like normal families. Some critics said the play glorified rich people, but most viewers loved it. The final scene took place in an old cemetery next to a church, where an actor read the words on a gravestone aloud, and the whole audience went silent.
items.passageZh: 每年夏天，我們城市的一個小劇團都會在公園演出一齣莎士比亞的戲。今年他們選了一個關於英國貴族階級的故事，裡面滿是國王、王子和祕密戀情。導演是一位人文主義者，相信藝術屬於每一個人，她想把老戲劇推廣給年輕人。所以她讓角色更有人性：驕傲的王子們會傳簡訊，也會像一般家庭一樣為錢吵架。有些評論家說這齣戲美化了有錢人，但大多數觀眾都很喜歡。最後一場戲發生在教堂旁的一座老墓地，一位演員大聲念出墓碑上的字，全場觀眾都安靜了下來。

questions.questionZh: 導演為什麼這樣改編角色？
options: 想讓年輕人也喜歡老戲劇
想讓貴族的故事更像真實歷史
想得到評論家的讚美和獎項

questions.questionZh: 最後一場戲在哪裡發生？

items.promptZh: 在那個時代，只有貴族階級才能受教育。
referenceEn: At that time, only the aristocracy could get an education.
In those days, only members of the aristocracy were able to receive an education.
rubricZh: 「貴族階級」可寫，例如 the aristocracy、members of the aristocracy 等
「受教育」可寫，例如 get an education、receive an education、go to school 等
時態合理（例如 could、were able to 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 humanize 造一個句子，說說一家公司或一種產品怎麼讓人覺得更有人情味。
referenceEn: The bank tried to humanize its service by letting customers talk to real people.
Cute robots help humanize technology for children.
rubricZh: humanize 後面接受詞（例如 humanize its service、humanize technology 等）
時態配合內容（例如 tried、help 等）
